title: Take heart, and be courageous, because He has overcome the world.
excerptHtml: Paul had faced enormous suffering in his life, even to the point of death, he writes. This suffering he experienced had literally taken him to the end of his rope. He COULD. NOT. GO. ON. ANYMORE.
